senses.gloss: m. (ארס) something tied to the body (περίαμμα), whence an emblem set in a ring or chain (cmp.
units: <cite ref="Deuteronomy 6:8">Deut. VI, 8</cite>; <cite ref="Proverbs 6:21">Prov. VI, 21</cite>, also Sm. Ant. s. v. Amuletum). .

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:7">Deut. R. s. 3</cite> <he>הכניסה לו שנים א׳</he> (read <cite ref="U01585"><he>שני</he></cite>) brought into his house two emblems (of faith); the king, too, <he>זקף לה כנגדן שני א׳</he> had two corresponding emblems set for her.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:7">Ib.</cite> Abraham delivered to his children <he>שני א׳</he> two emblems (which they should guard, <cite ref="Genesis 18:19">Gen. XVIII, 19</cite>).
